today_summary: GCM26 marks $4,408.5 on the 2026-09-14 chain, up just $1.7 from the 09-11 print — two sessions of dead-flat spot after the $53.5 break. The chain is the most call-lopsided of the window at 218,808 call OI vs 80,751 put OI (P/C 0.37), and flow is more extreme still: 15,129 call contracts traded against 2,003 puts, a 0.13 volume ratio, with 8,201 of those calls concentrated in the single $5,225 strike. Resistance is stacked at $4,500 (12,089 call OI, just $91.5 above spot), then $4,725 (9,607) and $5,500 (11,192); the only support inside 3% is the $4,300 put shelf at 3,536, with the $3,900 (3,936) and $3,500 (5,516) walls too far out to matter. Max pain prints $5,600, 27.0% above spot — a legacy artifact, not a magnet — and near-spot net GEX of +231.7 pins the tape inside a 1sigma band of $4,342.8–$4,474.2.
five_day_thesis: Five sessions ago spot was $4,476.0; it is $4,408.5 now, a $67.5 (-1.51%) decline that has gone completely flat over the last two prints. The defining event of the window was 09-11, when total call OI exploded 201,361 to 218,258 (+16,897) in one session on 24,999 contracts of volume — and it was two strikes, not a broad bid: $4,725 went 1,436 to 9,609 (+8,173) and $5,225 went 1,223 to 9,407 (+8,184), a matched ~8,200-lot structure that reads as a financed upside spread rather than outright demand. Spot's answer was nothing at all — $4,406.8 then $4,408.5 — so someone paid for 2026 upside while the front tape refused to move. That build dragged the cumulative gamma flip from $4,600 up to $4,700, pushing it $291.5 above spot and widening the short-gamma pocket underneath even as localized net GEX held positive at +231.7. Meanwhile the put side never engaged: the put wall has been frozen at $3,500 for all five sessions, put volume has drained to 2,003 contracts, and ATM IV is unchanged at 23.67% (-0.02pp) after a one-day 24.12% spike — nobody is paying for downside protection here.

prediction: Neutral-to-fade while spot holds below the $4,500 call wall. Positive near-spot GEX of +231.7 and a 23.67% IV argue for containment inside the 1sigma $4,342.8–$4,474.2 band, and the $16,357 of fresh call OI sits $317–$817 out of the money — it caps rallies before it fuels them. A sustained close above $4,500 invalidates the fade and opens $4,725; below $4,342 there is no real bid until the $4,300 put shelf at 3,536 OI, and beneath that spot is trading $400 under the gamma flip with nothing structural underneath.
